clips.title: The story
paras: Nestled in northwestern Teldrassil, the Oracle Glade is a sacred woodland sanctuary home to the wondrous Oracle Tree and the World Tree's premier moonwell. Despite its serene purpose as a center of communion and vigilance, the glade faces constant harassment from encroaching Bloodfeather harpies.

The Oracle Glade rests quietly between Darnassus and Wellspring Lake, serving as a vital nexus of night elven communion with nature. At its center stands the Oracle Tree, an ancient specimen whose massive boughs evoke the silhouette of an eagle perched atop a bear. Nearby shimmers the first and most potent of Teldrassil's sacred moonwells, an oasis of lunar magic bathed in Elune's grace. Alongside the Circle of the Ancients, the Oracle Tree watches over the island boughs, shedding inscribed bark that acts as vital communiques to Archdruid Fandral Staghelm regarding the World Tree's health.

The glade's tranquility is fragile. Aggressive Bloodfeather harpies have descended upon the grove, establishing roosts among the high branches and threatening the sacred tree. Sentinels dispatched from Darnassus struggle to root out the avian scavengers, who actively harass traveling druids and taint the natural serenity of the moonwell. Travelers passing through the northern boughs must tread lightly, as the harpies strike swiftly at any who venture near their roosts.
